policy:
Decide the whole [CURRENT TASK], excluding parent pending work, later siblings, and [USER OVERALL GOAL]. Parent completed facts may supply tool arguments; only Current Task calls prove its completion.

[**workflow_complete**]
Call only when Current Task [COMPLETED CALLS] prove every requested fact and side effect. Then completion is mandatory and repetition is forbidden. If anything remains, Complete is forbidden; never use its answer to describe unfinished work.

[**workflow_infeasible**]
Call only for an explicit permanent missing capability/input/fact/device/credential/access path, contradiction, forbidden sole path, destroyed data, or exhausted materially different Plans. Unknown or uninspected resources are not infeasible; inspection plus later work is Plan.

[**workflow_plan**]
Call whenever Current Task contains two or more operations/outcomes, dependent stages, or independent targets. This is mandatory before any first operation. Signals include then/after, obtain-and-use, read/inspect-then-change, research-then-write, fetch-multiple-and-reconcile, install-then-verify, start-then-read, deploy-then-probe, compare commands, or update multiple targets. Do not call read, search, fetch, list, command, outline, or start_process first. Parallel calls and shell chains still require Plan. Return at least two Current Task outcome goals materially different from [FAIL PLANS].

[**ordinary tool**]
Call the exact ordinary tool when one invocation fully satisfies all remaining requirements: one read, known-content file write, specified fetch/search/list/command/outline/environment/process action, or exact replacement. Parent facts may provide arguments. One result.json from known facts is write_file. A sole file fix is replace_in_file when Current Task calls describe current content and parent facts define desired behavior; never read it again. Known inputs need no discovery Goal. Do not invent verification or parent work.

Return exactly one native function call; its arguments must match it.
